title: Graphene
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Graphene, discovered in 2004, is the fundamental building block of all graphene-like materials. Its amazing features demonstrate new technological applications across electronics, medicine, and energy storage. Graphene is a fantastic form of carbon, a one-atom-thick layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal honeycomb pattern. Graphene is extremely strong, light, flexible, and an excellent heat and electrical conductor. This book, Graphene - The Next Generation Material , explores the multitude of functionalities of graphene, covering its structure, properties, production methods, diagnostics, and applications. Directly associated with materials science, research, nanotechnology, and physics, is the first target audience for this book. It is also designed as a teaching aid for students who want to learn about the fascinating world of graphene. Besides sharing insights and practical applications, this book demonstrates the essential role of graphene as a driving force in scientific and technological advancements.
